description: Comptage vélo - Données compteurs is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. ATTENTION:Au 08/09/2023, le jeu de données Comptage vélo - Données compteurs subit des dysfonctionnements qui peut altérer la véracité des informations transmises. Nos équipes techniques sont mobilisés pour résoudre le problème au plus vite. Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are vélo, comptage vélo, piste cyclable, DVD, IoT, bande cyclable. The portal shows 196 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
